greetings: Beep boop! Greetings, Agent! I'm CyBot, your cybersecurity tactical companion. Which district shall we protect today?
Systems operational! CyberCity's firewalls are holding, but we need your keen eyes in the districts.
Welcome back to CyberQuest HQ! Every mission you complete makes the digital world safer.

inactivityPrompt.title: CyBot Sensory Alert
inactivityPrompt.message: Are you still with us, Agent? CyberCity needs your defense! Press 'I'm Here!' to continue your mission.

districtBriefings.phishing: Welcome to Mailbox Quarter! Phishing traps lurk in plain sight. Always inspect sender addresses and hover over hyperlinks before deciding!
districtBriefings.password: Entering the Vault District! Remember, length creates exponential entropy, but brute force isn't the only threat. Master 2FA to seal the vault!
districtBriefings.ethical: Firewall Fortress ahead! White-hat defenders protect without harming. Make ethical choices that safeguard privacy and uphold digital integrity.
districtBriefings.flaws: Office Tower scan initialized! Look closely at the physical and digital environment. Real-world vulnerabilities are often hiding in plain view.
districtBriefings.quiz: Academy Amphitheater ready! Test your full tactical cybersecurity knowledge. Accuracy and streaks earn bonus XP!
districtBriefings.myths: Stepping into Myth Plaza! Many widespread digital beliefs are dangerous myths. Let's bust them with cold hard facts!
districtBriefings.ai: AI Lab online! Generative AI is a powerful tool, but deepfakes and data leaks require vigilant defenses. Stay sharp!
districtBriefings.bonus: Bonus Alley unlocked! Six quick tactical challenges await: Wi-Fi defense, QR traps, permissions, privacy, ciphers, and deepfakes!

rankPromotions.recruit: Rank Verified: Recruit. Your cybersecurity journey in CyberCity has officially begun!
rankPromotions.agent: Promoted to Agent! You've proven your ability to spot basic traps and defend your workstation.
rankPromotions.senior_agent: Promoted to Senior Agent! Your tactical analytical skills are making a measurable difference across CyberCity.
rankPromotions.expert: Promoted to Expert! Elite defense instincts unlocked. Only the highest rank remains!
rankPromotions.cyber_guardian: ALL HAIL THE CYBERGUARDIAN! You have secured every single district and achieved 1500 XP! Claim your official Diploma!

resetConfirmation: All local training data and XP have been reset. Welcome to your fresh start, Recruit!
